shared_elements: standing/frontal anthropomorphic figure filling the field
elaborate headdress or headgear above the head
circular disc or roundel on the chest/torso
horizontal banded ornament (belt or wrapped bands) at the waist
vertical hanging/pendant elements flanking the body
incised linear detailing of costume rather than modelled anatomy
justification: Both present a single vertically stacked anthropomorphic figure with a crowning headdress, a prominent circular disc on the chest, a banded belt or wrap at the waist and pendant elements falling below, which is a reasonably specific ordering of costume elements. The rendering differs completely, however: A is a crisp, densely detailed profile-headed ink drawing with legible ornaments and a held staff, while B is a heavily eroded, blocky frontal stone carving whose motifs are broad, sparse and largely illegible.
